notes: IFIP_SEC-X03_nonce_store (P04, venue ifip_sec, RQ2): delivered the linearizable consume-once nonce store at evaluation/venue2027/ifip_sec/nonce_store.py (NONCE_STORE_VERSION 1.0.0) with the manifest contract specialised as consume(nonce, expires_at, now) -> ConsumeResult over CONSUMED / REPLAY_DETECTED / EXPIRED (time always injected, no hidden clock; half-open validity window [issue, expires_at) so consumption at exactly expires_at fails closed as EXPIRED). InMemoryNonceBackend holds one real threading.Lock across check-and-claim (single critical section => N concurrent consumers of the SAME nonce admit exactly one, proven by barrier-synchronized threads at N in {2,4,8,16} x 5 repetitions); memory is bounded by expiry sweeps (opportunistic auto-sweep every sweep_interval consumes plus explicit sweep(now) reclaiming expired records).
